```{r load-sample-db}
# DNA/RNA database maps sample codes (A1, B1, I6, etc.) to cell lines and sample names
sample_db_path <- file.path(dirname(params$data_dir), "DNA_RNA database - DNA_RNA BOX1.csv")
sample_db <- data.table::fread(sample_db_path, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
sample_db <- as.data.frame(sample_db)
# Clean up: keep ID, Sample, Cell line columns; trim whitespace
sample_db <- sample_db %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Sample, `Cell line`) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ID), ID != "") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), trimws))
# Create named lookup vectors
sample_code_to_cellline <- setNames(sample_db$`Cell line`, sample_db$ID)
sample_code_to_sample <- setNames(sample_db$Sample, sample_db$ID)
cat(sprintf("Loaded %d sample codes from DNA/RNA database\n", nrow(sample_db)))
```

```{r harmonize-function}
# Known cell line patterns for matching
KNOWN_CELL_LINES <- c("HT1080", "A549", "H2452", "KP4", "LNCAP", "MEL270",
                       "HEPG2", "A375", "SKOV3")

# HT1080 clone prefixes (Oct 2024 data uses clone names like C2a, C7b)
HT1080_CLONES <- c("C2", "C4", "C7", "C8", "C24")

parse_cell_line <- function(name_str, run_str = NA_character_) {
  # Check name and run for known cell line patterns
  combined <- paste(name_str, run_str, sep = " ")
  combined_upper <- toupper(combined)

  for (cl in KNOWN_CELL_LINES) {
    if (grepl(toupper(cl), combined_upper, fixed = TRUE)) return(cl)
  }

  # Check for HT1080 clone names (e.g., C2a, C7b)
  if (!is.na(run_str)) {
    run_prefix <- str_extract(run_str, "^[A-Z]+[0-9]+")
    if (!is.na(run_prefix) && run_prefix %in% HT1080_CLONES) return("HT1080")
  }

  return(NA_character_)
}

parse_date <- function(date_str) {
  # Already ISO format
  if (grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", date_str)) return(as.Date(date_str))

  # Month lookup
  months <- c("JAN" = 1, "FEB" = 2, "MARCH" = 3, "MAR" = 3, "APR" = 4,
              "MAY" = 5, "JUNE" = 6, "JUN" = 6, "JULY" = 7, "JUL" = 7,
              "AUG" = 8, "SEP" = 9, "OCT" = 10, "NOV" = 11, "DEC" = 12)

  parts <- str_split(date_str, "_", simplify = TRUE)
  parts <- parts[parts != ""]

  if (length(parts) == 3) {
    # Could be DD_MONTH_YYYY or MONTH_DD_YYYY
    if (grepl("^[0-9]+$", parts[1]) && !grepl("^[0-9]+$", parts[2])) {
      # DD_MONTH_YYYY (e.g., 12_JUNE_2024, 29_OCT_2024)
      day <- as.integer(parts[1])
      month <- months[toupper(parts[2])]
      year <- as.integer(parts[3])
    } else {
      # MONTH_DD_YYYY (e.g., JAN_27_2025, NOV_13_2025)
      month <- months[toupper(parts[1])]
      day <- as.integer(parts[2])
      year <- as.integer(parts[3])
    }
    if (!is.na(month) && !is.na(day) && !is.na(year)) {
      return(as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", year, month, day)))
    }
  }

  return(NA)
}

harmonize_info_table <- function(filepath) {
  df <- data.table::fread(filepath, na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "Inf", "-Inf"))
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df <- as.data.frame(df)

  cols <- names(df)
  run_dir <- basename(dirname(filepath))

  # --- Detect schema version ---
  is_v1 <- "AMELX" %in% cols && "AMELY" %in% cols && !("Y-" %in% cols)
  is_v3 <- "AMELX_2_Conc" %in% cols
  # v2 is everything else

  # --- Droplet counts ---
  if (is_v1) {
    df$`Y-` <- df$AMELX
    df$`Y+` <- df$AMELY
  }
  # V2 and V3 already have Y- and Y+

  # Ensure core columns exist
  for (col in c("Y+", "Y-", "X+Y", "empty")) {
    if (!(col %in% names(df))) df[[col]] <- NA_integer_
  }

  # --- Well ---
  if (!("well" %in% cols)) {
    df$well <- str_extract(df$name, "^[A-H][0-9]{2}")
  }

  # --- TargetName ---
  if (!("TargetName" %in% cols)) {
    df$TargetName <- "AMELY"
  }

  # --- Cell line ---
  # V2 files have "Cell line" (with space) = actual cell line, and "cell_line" = sample code
  if ("Cell line" %in% cols) {
    df$cell_line <- trimws(df$`Cell line`)
    df$sample_code <- if ("cell_line" %in% cols) trimws(df$cell_line) else NA_character_
  } else if ("cell_line" %in% cols) {
    # Jan 27 2025: cell_line has actual cell line names (A549, HT1080, KP4)
    df$cell_line <- trimws(df$cell_line)
    df$sample_code <- NA_character_
  } else {
    # V1 files: no cell_line column; try parse_cell_line, then DNA/RNA database lookup
    run_col <- if ("run" %in% cols) df$run else NA_character_
    df$cell_line <- mapply(parse_cell_line, df$name,
                           if (is.character(run_col)) run_col else rep(NA_character_, nrow(df)),
                           USE.NAMES = FALSE)
    # For remaining NAs, look up sample code from the 'run' column in DNA/RNA database
    if ("run" %in% cols) {
      na_idx <- is.na(df$cell_line)
      codes <- trimws(df$run[na_idx])
      looked_up <- sample_code_to_cellline[codes]
      df$cell_line[na_idx] <- ifelse(is.na(looked_up), NA_character_, looked_up)
    }
    df$sample_code <- if ("run" %in% cols) trimws(df$run) else NA_character_
  }

  # --- Sample (use Sample column if available, else portion of name after well_) ---
  if ("Sample" %in% cols) {
    df$sample <- trimws(df$Sample)
  } else if ("run" %in% cols) {
    # For V1 files with coded run column, look up sample name from DNA/RNA database
    raw_sample <- sub("^[A-H][0-9]{2}_", "", df$name)
    looked_up_sample <- sample_code_to_sample[trimws(df$run)]
    df$sample <- ifelse(!is.na(looked_up_sample), looked_up_sample, raw_sample)
  } else {
    df$sample <- sub("^[A-H][0-9]{2}_", "", df$name)
  }

  # --- Ratio ---
  if (!("ratio" %in% cols)) df$ratio <- NA_real_
  df$ratio <- as.numeric(df$ratio)

  # --- Total ---
  df$total <- as.integer(df$`Y+`) + as.integer(df$`Y-`) +
              as.integer(df$`X+Y`) + as.integer(df$empty)

  # --- QC metrics ---
  if (!("empty_rate" %in% cols)) df$empty_rate <- NA_real_
  if (!("double_rate" %in% cols)) df$double_rate <- NA_real_
  df$empty_rate <- as.numeric(df$empty_rate)
  df$double_rate <- as.numeric(df$double_rate)

  # --- Date ---
  if ("date" %in% cols) {
    df$date_raw <- as.character(df$date)
  } else {
    df$date_raw <- NA_character_
  }

  # --- Concentration ---
  if (is_v3) {
    # V3: AMELX is Y-target conc, AMELX_2 is X-ref conc
    df$Conc_Y <- as.numeric(df$AMELX_Conc)
    df$Conc_X <- as.numeric(df$AMELX_2_Conc)
  } else if ("AMELY_Conc" %in% cols) {
    df$Conc_Y <- as.numeric(df$AMELY_Conc)
    df$Conc_X <- as.numeric(df$AMELX_Conc)
  } else if ("DDX3Y_Conc" %in% cols && df$TargetName[1] == "DDX3Y") {
    # DDX3Y target rows
    df$Conc_Y <- as.numeric(df$DDX3Y_Conc)
    df$Conc_X <- as.numeric(df$RNaseP_Conc)
  } else {
    df$Conc_Y <- NA_real_
    df$Conc_X <- NA_real_
  }

  if ("Conc_ratio" %in% cols) {
    df$Conc_ratio <- as.numeric(df$Conc_ratio)
  } else {
    df$Conc_ratio <- NA_real_
  }

  # --- Select unified columns ---
  df$run_dir <- run_dir

  out <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(name, well, cell_line, sample, TargetName,
                  `Y+`, `Y-`, `X+Y`, empty,
                  ratio, empty_rate, double_rate, total,
                  date_raw, run_dir,
                  Conc_Y, Conc_X, Conc_ratio)

  # Force types
  out$`Y+` <- as.integer(out$`Y+`)
  out$`Y-` <- as.integer(out$`Y-`)
  out$`X+Y` <- as.integer(out$`X+Y`)
  out$empty <- as.integer(out$empty)

  return(out)
}

# Y-linked targets (used to filter data_table.csv rows)
Y_TARGETS <- c("AMELY", "DDX3Y", "KDM5D")

harmonize_data_table <- function(filepath) {
  df <- data.table::fread(filepath, na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "No Call"))
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df <- as.data.frame(df)

  run_dir <- basename(dirname(filepath))

  # Filter to Y-linked target rows only (not RNaseP/AMELX reference rows)
  df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(Target %in% Y_TARGETS)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Build standard columns
  out <- data.frame(
    name       = paste0(df$Well, "_", df$`Sample description 1`),
    well       = df$Well,
    TargetName = df$Target,
    `Y+`       = as.integer(df$`Ch1+Ch2-`),   # FAM-only = Y-target positive
    `Y-`       = as.integer(df$`Ch1-Ch2+`),   # VIC-only = reference positive
    `X+Y`      = as.integer(df$`Ch1+Ch2+`),   # Both positive
    empty      = as.integer(df$`Ch1-Ch2-`),   # Neither positive
    Conc_Y     = as.numeric(df$`Conc(copies/µL)`),
    Conc_ratio = as.numeric(df$Ratio),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
  )

  # Get reference (RNaseP/AMELX) concentration from the paired row
  df_ref <- data.table::fread(filepath, na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "No Call"))
  df_ref <- as.data.frame(df_ref)
  df_ref <- df_ref %>% dplyr::filter(!(Target %in% Y_TARGETS))
  if (nrow(df_ref) > 0) {
    ref_conc <- setNames(as.numeric(df_ref$`Conc(copies/µL)`), df_ref$Well)
    out$Conc_X <- ref_conc[out$well]
  } else {
    out$Conc_X <- NA_real_
  }

  # Compute droplet ratio: (Y+ + X+Y) / (Y- + X+Y)
  out$ratio <- (out$`Y+` + out$`X+Y`) / (out$`Y-` + out$`X+Y`)
  out$total <- out$`Y+` + out$`Y-` + out$`X+Y` + out$empty
  out$empty_rate <- out$empty / out$total
  out$double_rate <- out$`X+Y` / out$total

  # Cell line from sample name
  sample_desc <- df$`Sample description 1`
  out$cell_line <- sapply(sample_desc, function(s) parse_cell_line(s), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  out$sample <- sample_desc

  # Date from run_dir folder name (extract ISO date from end)
  date_match <- str_extract(run_dir, "\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}")
  out$date_raw <- if (!is.na(date_match)) date_match else NA_character_
  out$run_dir <- run_dir

  out <- out %>%
    dplyr::select(name, well, cell_line, sample, TargetName,
                  `Y+`, `Y-`, `X+Y`, empty,
                  ratio, empty_rate, double_rate, total,
                  date_raw, run_dir,
                  Conc_Y, Conc_X, Conc_ratio)

  return(out)
}
```

```{r discover-data-tables}
# Find data_table.csv files in run directories that lack INFO_TABLE.csv
info_dirs <- dirname(info_files)
all_run_dirs <- list.dirs(params$data_dir, recursive = FALSE)
dt_files <- c()
for (d in all_run_dirs) {
  if (!(d %in% info_dirs) && file.exists(file.path(d, "data_table.csv"))) {
    dt_files <- c(dt_files, file.path(d, "data_table.csv"))
  }
}
cat(sprintf("Found %d data_table.csv files (no INFO_TABLE)\n", length(dt_files)))
```

```{r load-all}
# Load INFO_TABLE files
info_data <- lapply(info_files, function(f) {
  tryCatch(harmonize_info_table(f),
           error = function(e) {
             message(sprintf("Error loading %s: %s", basename(dirname(f)), e$message))
             return(NULL)
           })
})
info_data <- info_data[!sapply(info_data, is.null)]

# Load data_table files
dt_data <- lapply(dt_files, function(f) {
  tryCatch(harmonize_data_table(f),
           error = function(e) {
             message(sprintf("Error loading %s: %s", basename(dirname(f)), e$message))
             return(NULL)
           })
})
dt_data <- dt_data[!sapply(dt_data, is.null)]

all_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(c(info_data, dt_data))

# Drop rows with all-NA droplet counts (empty plate entries)
all_data <- all_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(`Y+`) | !is.na(`Y-`) | !is.na(`X+Y`))

# Also drop rows where ratio is NA and all counts are 0 or NA
all_data <- all_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(is.na(ratio) & (is.na(total) | total == 0)))

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d wells across %d runs\n",
            nrow(all_data), length(unique(all_data$run_dir))))
```

```{r parse-dates}
# Parse dates to proper Date objects
all_data$date <- sapply(all_data$date_raw, function(d) {
  if (is.na(d)) return(NA)
  as.character(parse_date(d))
}, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
all_data$date <- as.Date(all_data$date)

# Sort by date
all_data <- all_data %>% dplyr::arrange(date, run_dir, name)

# Date label for plots (shorter)
all_data$date_label <- format(all_data$date, "%b %Y")
all_data$date_label <- factor(all_data$date_label,
  levels = unique(all_data$date_label[order(all_data$date)]))
```

# Parse Cell Line & Condition

```{r parse-condition}
# Condition parsing from sample name
all_data$condition <- dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("MIX", all_data$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "MIX",
  grepl("LOY", all_data$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "LOY",
  grepl("sgCTRL|CTRL|CN\\b", all_data$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "CTRL",
  grepl("Parental|WT|WILD", all_data$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Parental",
  grepl("gDNA", all_data$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "gDNA",
  grepl("Q53|CP", all_data$sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "LOY",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

# Condition factor
all_data$condition <- factor(all_data$condition,
  levels = c("Parental", "gDNA", "CTRL", "LOY", "MIX", "Other"))
```

```{r run-summary}
run_counts <- all_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(run_dir, date, date_label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_wells = dplyr::n(),
                   cell_lines = paste(unique(na.omit(cell_line)), collapse = ", "),
                   targets = paste(unique(TargetName), collapse = ", "),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date)

knitr::kable(run_counts, caption = "Runs loaded")
```

# Master Ratio Overview {.tabset}

## By Date (faceted by cell line)

```{r master-overview, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
condition_pal <- c("Parental" = "#00A087", "gDNA" = "#8491B4",
                   "CTRL" = "#4DBBD5", "LOY" = "#E64B35",
                   "MIX" = "#7E6148", "Other" = "grey50")

plot_data <- all_data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(cell_line), !is.na(ratio))

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = date_label, y = ratio, color = condition)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = condition_pal, name = "Condition") +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_line, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.5)) +
  labs(title = "AMELY/AMELX Ratio — All Experiments",
       subtitle = "Each point = one well; dashed line = expected diploid male (0.5)",
       x = "Run Date", y = "Y / X Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Target Comparison

```{r target-comparison, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}
# Find samples that have both AMELY and DDX3Y measurements in the same run
# Use well + run_dir as unique ID, and average if still duplicated
dual_target <- all_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(TargetName %in% c("AMELY", "DDX3Y"), !is.na(ratio)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(well, sample, run_dir, cell_line, condition, TargetName) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(ratio = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = TargetName, values_from = ratio,
                     id_cols = c(well, sample, run_dir, cell_line, condition))

dual_target <- dual_target %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(AMELY), !is.na(DDX3Y))

if (nrow(dual_target) > 0) {
  cor_val <- round(cor(dual_target$AMELY, dual_target$DDX3Y, use = "complete.obs"), 3)

  ggplot(dual_target, aes(x = AMELY, y = DDX3Y, color = cell_line)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.3), ylim = c(0, 1.3)) +
    labs(title = "Target Comparison: AMELY/AMELX vs DDX3Y/RNaseP",
         subtitle = sprintf("r = %s; dashed = identity line", cor_val),
         x = "AMELY / AMELX Ratio", y = "DDX3Y / RNaseP Ratio",
         color = "Cell Line") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
} else {
  cat("No samples with both AMELY and DDX3Y measurements found.")
}
```

# Summary Tables {.tabset}

## Per-Well (Interactive)

```{r per-well-table}
display_data <- all_data %>%
  dplyr::select(name, cell_line, sample, condition, TargetName,
                `Y+`, `Y-`, `X+Y`, empty, ratio, total,
                empty_rate, double_rate, date, run_dir, Conc_ratio) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4)))

DT::datatable(display_data,
              caption = "All wells — click column headers to sort",
              filter = "top",
              options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE))
```

## Per Cell Line x Condition

```{r cellline-condition-table}
summary_table <- all_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cell_line), !is.na(ratio),
                condition %in% c("Parental", "CTRL", "LOY", "MIX")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_line, condition, TargetName) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_wells = dplyr::n(),
    n_runs = length(unique(run_dir)),
    mean_ratio = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ratio = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ratio = min(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ratio = max(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cell_line, condition, TargetName)

knitr::kable(summary_table,
  caption = "Mean ratio per cell line, condition, and target",
  col.names = c("Cell Line", "Condition", "Target", "N Wells", "N Runs",
                "Mean Ratio", "SD", "Min", "Max"))
```

## Per Run

```{r per-run-table}
per_run <- all_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ratio)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(run_dir, date, cell_line, condition, TargetName) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_wells = dplyr::n(),
    mean_ratio = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ratio = sd(ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_empty_rate = mean(empty_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 4))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date, cell_line)

DT::datatable(per_run,
              caption = "Per-run summary",
              filter = "top",
              options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE))
```

# Output

```{r write-summary}
out_path <- file.path(params$data_dir, "summary_all_INFO_TABLES.csv")
# Try writing; if locked, write to a timestamped backup
tryCatch({
  data.table::fwrite(all_data, file = out_path)
  cat(sprintf("Summary written to: %s\n%d rows, %d columns\n",
              out_path, nrow(all_data), ncol(all_data)))
}, error = function(e) {
  backup_path <- file.path(params$data_dir,
    paste0("summary_all_INFO_TABLES_", format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"), ".csv"))
  data.table::fwrite(all_data, file = backup_path)
  cat(sprintf("Original file locked — written to backup: %s\n%d rows, %d columns\n",
              backup_path, nrow(all_data), ncol(all_data)))
})
```
